final: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT c.location AS city, COUNT(*) AS city_count FROM qualifying AS q JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.location), overall AS (SELECT AVG(city_count) AS average_count FROM city_counts), kept AS (SELECT cc.city_count, cc.city_count - o.average_count AS difference FROM city_counts AS cc CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.average_count IS NOT NULL AND cc.city_count > o.average_count) SELECT AVG(city_count) AS average_kept_count, AVG(difference) AS average_difference FROM kept
